meta.rank_is_placeholder: rank and architecture of the single-run tables are those requested on the command line or configs/base.yaml; the manuscript rank is decided by the author (not by this script)

reference_check.note: values recomputed here against analysis/drymass.json, phase_integral.json and architecture_comparison.json of outputs/full (seed-42 runs); a difference means that earlier file is out of date

meta.class_name_note: mask value 2 = spherocyte, 3 = echinocyte (D-25); the pipeline files use the opposite names for 2 and 3

units.*_pct: percent = 100 x fraction produced by the evaluation code
units.dry_mass: pg, physical constants only (no MCH calibration)

train_float_coverage.warning: 74 base training images have no float32 map and are excluded (missing_float_data.csv)

ms_meta.note: class names in manuscript order (mask value 2 = spherocyte, 3 = echinocyte), D-25

phase_offsets.note: validation images; offset = median phase of annotated background (more than background_exclusion_px from any cell) of the map as provided, subtracted once in prepare_dataset (D-03)

protocol.scope: model forward pass only, deployment input size per architecture
protocol.weights: trained reference checkpoint (best.pt of the selected rank), LoRA merged
protocol.ort_session_pooling: inside one seed the timed runs of the fresh sessions are pooled

metrics.latency_p50_ms: 50th percentile of the per-inference latencies of one seed
metrics.latency_p99_ms: 99th percentile of the per-inference latencies of one seed
metrics.peak_vram_mb: device-level GPU memory used after the timed loop minus before the model was placed (weights, activations, workspace, device inputs; CUDA context excluded); ONNX Runtime: largest value over the fresh sessions of the seed

protocol.aggregation: per-seed values; summary = mean and sample SD (n - 1) over seeds of the per-seed values; latency samples of different seeds are not pooled
